slots.name: Tiny Gym, Cartwheels Gym Centre (12 Armstrong Ave., Georgetown)

slots.name: Tumble & Learn (Tumble n' Learn), Cartwheels Gym Centre (12 Armstrong Ave., Georgetown)

slots.when: 9:30-11:30 in the Term 1 grid (September 14 to November 1, 2026), and Term 2 runs November 2 to December 20, 2026. The text I read does not show which weekday this class runs, so check the PDF grid for the day.
